title: Book Two · Chapter 197: The Decision Is Made
story:
By late spring, Leo's family makes its decision. Next school year, he will go to the school in the other city. He will stay with his aunt at first.

He tells Ronan after lessons. They stand near the same steps as before. Here they once read the questions about the new school.

“After the summer?” Ronan asks.

“Near the end of it. We need time to settle in.”

“And your group place?”

“Mei and I finish this school year's work before that. Miss Wu knows.”

Ronan nods. This will not give Ronan an empty group place. Leo will finish his work this year. Then he will start at his new school.

“Are you happy?” Ronan asks.

Leo rubs a mark on the step with his shoe.

“Some days. Today I told my mother I want to take the old chair from my room.”

“On the train?”

“She asked the same thing.”

Ronan tries to imagine Leo in a crowded carriage with a chair on his knees. He starts to laugh. Leo laughs too, then stops first.

“The new room has a chair,” he says. “It just is not mine.”

They sit quietly. Ronan understands that more easily than the new classes and travel plan.

“You can take the nose leaf,” he says at last.

“That leaf is long gone.”

“We can find another.”

Leo smiles. He takes a short sheet from his pocket. It has the new address, carefully written by his aunt. He has copied it onto a second piece for Ronan.

Ronan reads it slowly and puts it in his book.

“You can send your address too,” Leo says.

“You know the green door.”

“I know it. Put the street and number on the paper anyway.”

They walk home. At Mr Qiu's table, Leo buys a thin exercise book for the new school. Ronan looks at the fresh pages and feels envy again. Leo will have a new city and new classes. He has a whole empty book for them.

Then Leo asks if Ronan can come to his house on Saturday. He wants to choose some old books to leave here. He asks Ronan to help him choose.

“You are leaving some?”

“I am not taking the whole shelf.”

“The chair will need space.”

Leo pushes his shoulder gently. Ronan pushes back. They go the last part of River Street side by side.

At home, Ronan writes his own address in clear letters. He checks the street number with Mum, then folds the note for Leo. He puts it beside the new address. Both pieces of paper fit inside the birthday book.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

decision＝决定；settle in＝安顿下来；carriage＝火车车厢；address＝地址。

## 理解问题

1. Leo迁读的时间和原因怎样与本学年正式席位区分？
2. 他对旧椅子的不舍让Ronan理解了什么？

## 读句子

**Both pieces of paper fit inside the birthday book.**

拆开看：Both pieces of paper / fit / inside the birthday book.

两张纸／都放得下／在那本生日书里。
